original_ai_output.title_zh: 夸拉州警方逮捕涉嫌虐待儿童、谋杀及绑架的多名嫌疑人
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚夸拉州警方在分别进行的调查中逮捕了多名嫌疑人，涉及虐待儿童、谋杀、绑架、疑似与仪式相关的犯罪以及摩托车盗窃等案件。据称，一名12岁女孩深夜在药店购买物品时被居民发现，从而揭发了一起疑似家庭虐待案。警方表示，这些逮捕行动基于公众举报、情报收集、调查以及与当地猎人和治安团体的合作。目前信息仅来自单一来源。

location.raw_text: Kwara State, Nigeria; Idigba area of Adewole, Ilorin

key_facts.fact: 夸拉州警方逮捕了涉及虐待儿童、谋杀、绑架等案件的多名嫌疑人
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The exposure has led the police in Kwara State to arrest several suspects in separate investigations involving child abuse, murder, kidnapping, suspected ritual-related offences and motorcycle theft.

key_facts.fact: 一名12岁女孩疑似遭受家庭虐待的案件因居民发现其深夜购买物品而曝光
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: A concerned resident’s decision to question a 12-year-old girl seen buying a substance from a chemist late at night has helped to expose an alleged case of domestic torture in Kwara State.

key_facts.fact: 案件曝光时间为2026年9月30日，地点在伊洛林Adewole的Idigba地区
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: whose alleged ordeal came to light on September 30, 2026, when a resident of the Idigba area of Adewole, Ilorin, spotted her purchasing GV solution from a nearby chemist shop at about 9.26 pm.

uncertainties: 家庭虐待指控尚未证实，仅为据称
仪式相关犯罪被描述为疑似
目前仅有一个来源（Punch），尚缺乏交叉验证
